matches.rationale: No finding addresses the projection function ψ or its inconsistent definitions across meta-learners (optimization-based, metric-based, amortization-based, ICL). All findings target either the Lemma 1/Theorem 1 proof chain in Appendix B or computational-cost/training-procedure counts in Appendix A/Section 3.1, none of which concern ψ's construction.

GT2 concerns the validity/rigor of Lemma 1 and Theorem 1 (claimed to be 'unproven as stated' due to omitted assumptions). Findings 1-5 all target exactly this Lemma 1/Theorem 1 proof chain in Appendix B and substantiate the suspicion by exhibiting concrete logical/algebraic failures in the proof, satisfying R3 (mechanism vs. detectable consequence) even though they surface at the proof level rather than the vague-wording level described in the GT.
No finding discusses the sampling strategy π_κ for inner-task distance subsets or its underspecification; all findings are about proof correctness or computational complexity/training-loop counts.
